title: Grateful Dead Live at City Island on 1984-06-23
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi Dragon) > Pro Tools 12 > .wav 24/96 > Adobe Audition 2023 > TLH2496
source: Rob Eaton's Master Audience Cassettes; (2) Neumann U87's + (2) AKG 414's > Rolls MPX42 mixer > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures an imaginative set with punchy Weir, great Garcia vocals and standout renditions of Alabama Getaway, Touch of Grey and Estimated Prophet.
ai_review.review: The tape is a strong audience capture that delivers clear vocal presence and a lively atmosphere. Reviewers rave about the opener “Alabama,” a rowdy take on “Touch of Grey,” and an inspired “Estimated Prophet” jam, plus a soaring drum‑and‑space segment that leads into a triumphant Truckin’ finish. Overall the performance feels energetic, varied and expertly executed.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed, enthusiastic review highlights a high‑energy show with multiple standout moments and a strong audience recording; weight leans heavily to the musical performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes it as a “Strong Audience recording” with clear vocals, good instrument separation and an overall crisp feel despite being non‑soundboard.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Imaginative set list with multiple peaks; opener “Alabama” sets a high bar, first‑set builds energy, and the second half features a rowdy Touch, soaring drums/space, and a triumphant Truckin’ finish.

band_member_comments.Bob: Weir is punchy with his guitar work.
